DealDex: https://github.com/jaywedgeworth22/DealDex

Read AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md first.  Work on your seat prefix
(`grok-build/` for Grok Build, `grok/` for Mac Grok, `claude/`, `cursor/`, …).
Pull rebase from origin/main before editing.  Commit, open a PR, merge
when CI is green.  Never force-push main.  Never invent a second repo.

GitHub `main` is the product.  Vercel Production builds that branch.
Coolify is not wired.  Do not invent a live URL.  Native apps are
Kotlin/Compose (`me.grok.dealdex`) and Swift (`online.dealdex`, team
`CC8UTF7ATG`), not a website wrapper.
